func DiffBuildInfo(fileA, fileB, fileC string) (int, error) {
    diffCount := 0
    start := time.Now()
    
    // 使用分片map减少内存占用
    const numShards = 256 // 256个分片，每个分片约处理200万行（5000万行/256）
    hashSets := make([]map[uint64]struct{}, numShards)
    for i := range hashSets {
        hashSets[i] = make(map[uint64]struct{})
    }
    
    // 分片函数
    getShard := func(hash uint64) int {
        return int(hash) & (numShards - 1) // 使用低8位进行分片
    }
    
    // 第一步：读取文件B构建分片哈希集合
    bFile, err := os.Open(fileB)
    if err != nil {
        return diffCount, err
    }
    defer bFile.Close()

    bScanner := bufio.NewScanner(bFile)
    bufB := make([]byte, 0, 64*1024)
	bScanner.Buffer(bufB, 10*1024*1024)
    
    var buildInfoExportdata BuildInfoExportdata
    lineCountB := 0
    for bScanner.Scan() {
        line := bScanner.Bytes()
        if err := sonic.Unmarshal(line, &buildInfoExportdata); err != nil {
            fmt.Printf("B文件解析错误@行%d: %v\n", lineCountB, err)
            continue
        }
        hash := hashLine([]byte(buildInfoExportdata.Short))
        shard := getShard(hash)
        hashSets[shard][hash] = struct{}{}
        lineCountB++
        
        if lineCountB%1000000 == 0 {
            fmt.Printf("已读取B文件 %d 行\n", lineCountB)
        }
    }
    if err := bScanner.Err(); err != nil {
        return diffCount, err
    }

    // 第二步：比较文件A并写入文件C
    aFile, err := os.Open(fileA)
    if err != nil {
        return diffCount, err
    }
    defer aFile.Close()

    cFile, err := os.Create(fileC)
    if err != nil {
        return diffCount, err
    }
    defer cFile.Close()
    
    writer := bufio.NewWriter(cFile)
    defer writer.Flush()

    aScanner := bufio.NewScanner(aFile)
	bufA := make([]byte, 0, 64*1024)  
	aScanner.Buffer(bufA, 10*1024*1024)
    lineCountA := 0
    
    for aScanner.Scan() {
        lineCountA++
        line := aScanner.Text()
        hash := hashLine([]byte(line))
        shard := getShard(hash)
        
        if _, exists := hashSets[shard][hash]; !exists {
            if _, err := writer.Write([]byte(line)); err != nil {
                return diffCount, err
            }
            if err := writer.WriteByte('\n'); err != nil {
                return diffCount, err
            }
            diffCount++
            if lineCountA%1000000 == 0 {
                fmt.Printf("已处理A文件 %d 行，发现差异行 %d\n", lineCountA, diffCount)
            }
        }
    }
    
    if err := aScanner.Err(); err != nil {
        return diffCount, err
    }
    
    fmt.Printf("处理完成！文件A共 %d 行，文件B共 %d 行，共写入 %d 行差异数据，耗时: %v\n", 
        lineCountA, lineCountB, diffCount, time.Since(start))
    return diffCount, nil
}
